titleEn: The Glory of Kings — Solomon Pleads with His Son to Stay (ch. 37)
part: ch. 37 — Solomon Pleads with His Son to Stay
about: Solomon asks his son, who wants to leave for his mother's country, why he would abandon the kingdom of Israel. The son replies that his mother made him swear to come home; the king offers him the throne, a wedding, a promise of the covenant land, and the Ark, and the son answers that he still must go. The king's argument about his own birth, from David and Bathsheba, is the chapter's heart. A few words are uncertain and are marked (?).

sentences.i: Chapter 37: How Solomon questioned his son.
sentences.n: Chapter heading. ተስእሎ 'questioning' is a verbal noun (infinitive) followed by its subject ሰሎሞን, so 'questioning-of Solomon'; ለወልዱ 'to his son' = ለ- 'to' + ወልድ 'son' + -ሁ 'his' (contracted to ወልዱ). ኀበ is normally 'where, to'; here it is rendered 'where' in `l` and 'how' in `i`, a loose sense of 'on the occasion when' (?). ፴፯ is the Geʿez numeral 37 (30 + 7).

sentences.t: ወካዕበ ፡ ነገሮ ፡ እንተ ፡ ባሕቲቱ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ለወልዱ ፡ ለምንት ፡ ትፈቅድ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትርሐቅ ፡ እምኔየ ፡ ምንተ ፡ ኀጣእከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትሖርብሔረ ፡ አረሚ ፡ ወምንት ፡ አጽሀቀከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትኅድግ ፡ መንግሥተ ፡ እስራኤል ።
sentences.l: And-again spoke-to-him in-private Solomon and-said-to-him to-his-son: Why you-wish that you-go-far from-me? What have-you-lacked that you-go (to) land-of foreigners, and-what has-made-you-despise that you-leave kingdom-of Israel?
sentences.i: And once more Solomon spoke with him alone, and said to his son: 'Why do you want to go far away from me? What do you lack, that you should go to a land of foreigners? And what has made you scorn the kingdom of Israel, that you would leave it?'
sentences.n: ወይቤሎ 'and he said to him': ወ- 'and' + ይቤ 'he said' + -ሎ 'to him'; the verb ይቤ is the regular opener of direct speech, and the same pronoun suffixes (-ሎ 'to him', -ኦ 'him', -ኒ 'me', -ከ 'you') recur on nearly every verb here. ነገሮ 'he spoke to him' = ነገረ + -ኦ (contracted). እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'by himself, in private' (lit. 'that which is his aloneness'). ለምንት 'why'. ትፈቅድ is a 2nd-person imperfect ('you wish'); ትርሐቅ has the same shape but is a subjunctive after ከመ 'that' ('that you go far'). ትሖርብሔረ is printed as one word in Bezold; read ትሖር ብሔረ 'you go (to) the land of', with ብሔር 'land' in the construct. አረሚ 'foreigners, pagans' (?) — a form not certain to me, taken from the root for 'foreign/uncircumcised'. አጽሀቀከ 'has made you scorn' (causative of ጸሐቀ 'laugh, mock'; the sense 'scorn' is a guess, ?). መንግሥተ እስራኤል 'kingdom-of Israel', construct chain.

sentences.t: አውሥዓወልዱ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ኢይከውነኒ ፡ እንበር ፡ ዝየ ፡ አላ ፡ እሖር ፡ ኀበ ፡ እምየእንዘ ፡ አንተ ፡ ትድኅረኒ ፤
sentences.l: Answered his-son and-said-to-him: Not it-is-possible-for-me that-I-stay here, but that-I-go to my-mother, while you after-me.
sentences.i: His son answered him: 'I cannot stay here; I must go to my mother, while you remain behind me (?).
sentences.n: አውሥዓወልዱ is two words run together in Bezold: አውሥዓ (= አውሥአ) ወልዱ 'he answered, his son (did)'. ኢይከውነኒ 'it will not be possible for me' (lit. 'it will not be to me'), with the suffix -ኒ 'to me'. እንበር and እሖር are subjunctives of 'I stay' and 'I go'. እምየእንዘ is also run together: እምየ እንዘ 'my mother, while'. ትድኅረኒ 'you are behind me, you remain after me' (the son leaves, the father stays); a sense 'you succeed me' is also possible (?). The son is Menelik, never named in this chapter.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ብከ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ዘይኄይስ ፡ እምኔየ ፡ ኢዮርብዓም ፡ ዘተወልደ ፡ በሕግ ፡ እምብእሲትከ ፡ ወእምየሰ ፡ ኢኮነት ፡ እንቲአከ ፡ ብእሲተ ፡ ዘበሕግ ።
sentences.l: For there-is-to-you a-son who-is-better than-me, Jeroboam, who-was-born by-law from-your-wife; and-my-mother indeed not-was your wife who-by-law.
sentences.i: For you have a son who is better than I, Jeroboam, born lawfully of your wife; but my mother was not your wife by law.'
sentences.n: Jeroboam: in this book the name ኢዮርብዓም stands for Solomon's legitimate heir, whom the Bible calls Rehoboam; Bezold prints ኢዮርብዓም and so do we. ብከ 'there is to you' = በ- 'in/with' + -ከ 'you', the Geʿez way of saying 'you have'. ዘይኄይስ እምኔየ 'who is better than me' (እም- + -ኔየ) (comparative by እም-). ዘተወልደ 'who was born' (passive stem ተወልደ). በሕግ 'by law, lawfully' (በ- 'in/by'). ወእምየሰ 'and my mother, for her part' (-ሰ is a contrastive particle). ኢኮነት 'she was not', the negative of ኮነት.

sentences.t: አውሥኦ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ወለእመትቤ ፡ ከመዝ ፡ አነሂ ፡ ኢኮንኩ ፡ ዘበሕግ ፡ ውሉዶ ፡ ለአቡየ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ እስመ ፡ ነሥአ ፡ ብእሲተ ፡ ባዕድ ፡ ወአቅተሎ ፡ ኪያሁኒ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ፀብእ ፡ ወወለደኒ ፡ ኪያየ ፡ እምኔሃ ፡ እስመ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ መሓሪ ፡ ሰረየ ፡ ሎቱ ፤
sentences.l: Answered-him the-king and-said-to-him: And-if you-say thus, I-too am-not one-by-law, his-son of-my-father David, for he-took wife-of another and-killed-him, him-too, in battle, and-begot-me, me, from-her; for God (is) merciful, he-forgave to-him;
sentences.i: The king answered him: 'If you say so, then I too am not the lawful son of my father David. He took another man's wife and killed him, too, in battle, and fathered me, me myself, by her. But since God is merciful, He forgave him;
sentences.n: ወለእመትቤ is printed as one word: ወለእመ ትቤ ከመዝ 'and if you say thus' (ትቤ is the 2ms of ይቤ 'say'; it could also be 3fs 'she says', but 'you' fits Solomon's argument). አነሂ 'I too' (-ሂ 'also'). ኢኮንኩ 'I am not'. ውሉዶ ለአቡየ ዳዊት 'son-of my-father David': ውሉድ 'son' + the pronoun -ሁ ('his') anticipating the possessor, then ለ- marking it, a common Geʿez way to write a genitive ('his son, of my father'). It is not a construct form. This alludes to 2 Samuel 11: David, Bathsheba and Uriah. ኪያሁኒ 'him also' and ኪያየ 'me (myself)' are emphatic object pronouns. መሓሪ 'merciful' (active participle). ሰረየ ሎቱ 'he pardoned him' (ሰረየ 'forgive', ?: the ሰ-ረ-የ root, 'remit'); cf. Psalm 51.

sentences.t: ወመኑ ፡ ዘየአኪ ፡ ወየአብድ ፡ እምነ ፡ እጓለ ፡ እመሕያው ፡ ወመኑ ፡ ዘይምሕር ፡ ወይጠብብ ፡ ከመ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: and-who (is) one-who-errs and-acts-foolishly from sons-of man, and-who (is) one-who-is-merciful and-wise like God;
sentences.i: for who among the sons of men does not err and act foolishly, and who is merciful and wise as God is?
sentences.n: Two rhetorical questions with ወመኑ ዘ- 'and who (is) he who...'. የአኪ 'he errs, does wrong' (?) — a rare verb that I read as 'he is wicked' from the root አከየ; ይጠብብ 'he is wise', ይምሕር 'he is merciful'; ወየአብድ 'and he acts foolishly'. እጓለ እመሕያው 'sons-of man' (lit. 'offspring-of the-mother-of-the-living'), the usual Geʿez idiom for 'human beings', cf. Psalm 8:4. ከመ 'like, as' before እግዚኣብሔር 'God'; the divine name is written thus throughout the book.

sentences.t: ሊተኒ ፡ እምአቡየ ፡ ወለከኒ ፡ እምኔየ ፡ ገብረ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ በከመ ፡ ፈቀደ ።
sentences.l: Mine (is) from-my-father, and-yours from-me; did God as he-willed.
sentences.i: What is mine came from my father, and what is yours comes from me (?); God has done as He pleased.
sentences.n: ሊተኒ 'to me indeed' and ለከኒ 'to you indeed': ሊተ / ለከ are the independent 'to me / to you' forms, with -ኒ 'also, indeed'; the sentence has no verb ('mine from my father, yours from me'), so I supply 'what is mine / what is yours' (?). ገብረ እግዚኣብሔር 'God did' (verb first, subject after, the normal word order). በከመ ፈቀደ 'as he wished'; cf. Psalm 115:3 (113:11 in the Geʿez/Greek count).

sentences.t: ወአንተሰ ፡ ኦወልድየ ፡ ፍርሆ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ አምላክነ ፡ ኢትግፋዕ ፡ ገጸ ፡ አቡከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢትርከብከ ፡ በደኃሪ ፡ ግፍዕ ፡ እምነ ፡ ዘይወፅእ ፡ እምነ ፡ ሐቌከ ፡ ወከመ ፡ ይሠኒ ፡ ዘርእከ ፡ በዲበ ፡ ምድር ።
sentences.l: And-you, O my-son, fear-him to-God our-God; do-not thrust-aside face-of your-father, lest it-overtake-you in-the-end injustice from him who goes-out from your-loins, and-that may-prosper your-seed upon the-earth.
sentences.i: As for you, my son, fear God, our God. Do not spurn the face of your father, so that no injustice may overtake you in the end from one who comes out of your own loins, and so that your seed may prosper upon the earth.
sentences.n: ወአንተሰ 'and you, for your part' (-ሰ). ኦወልድየ 'O my son' (ኦ is the vocative). ፍርሆ is the imperative 'fear' plus an object suffix, followed by ለእግዚኣብሔር; read 'fear (him,) God'. ኢትግፋዕ 'do not push away' is the prohibition (ኢ- + imperfect), here with ገጸ አቡከ 'face-of your-father' (construct). ከመ ኢትርከብከ 'lest it find you', the negative purpose clause. ደኃሪ 'the end, the last'. ሐቌ 'loins'. ይሠኒ is the subjunctive of ሠነየ 'be good, prosper'. ዘርእከ 'your seed' (ዘርእ, a variant spelling of ዘር 'seed', + -ከ).

sentences.t: ወውእቱሰ ፡ ኢዮርብዓም ፡ ሕፃን ፡ ዘ፮ ፡ ዓም ፡ ወአንተ ፡ ቀዳሜ ፡ በኵርየ ፡ ወበጻሕከ ፡ ለነጊሥ ፡ ወአንሥኦ ፡ ኵናቶ ፡ ለዘ ፡ ወለደከ ።
sentences.l: And-he, Jeroboam, (is) a-child of-6 years, and-you (are) first, my-firstborn, and-you-have-reached to-reign, and to-lift (?) his-spear of-him who begot-you.
sentences.i: Jeroboam is a child of six years, but you are my first, my firstborn, and you have come of age to reign, and to take up the spear of the one who fathered you (?).
sentences.n: ዘ፮ ዓም 'of six years', with the Geʿez numeral ፮ = 6 (spoken ስድስቱ); ዓም is a short form of ዓመት 'year'. ቀዳሜ በኵርየ 'first, my firstborn' (በኵር 'firstborn'). ወበጻሕከ 'you have arrived' (በጽሐ 'arrive, reach') + ለነጊሥ 'to reign', infinitive. ወአንሥኦ ኵናቶ ለዘ ወለደከ: the grammar is unclear (?). The house entry for ወአንሥኦ is 'and he raised him' (3ms perfect + -ኦ); here the following ኵናቶ would then lack a role, so I read አንሥኦ as an infinitive 'to lift up' with ኵናት 'spear' + -ሁ, 'the spear-of him' who begot you; Bezold's printing ለዘ ወለደከ has a word-space after ዘ. Whether it means 'to take up my spear' or 'to lift the spear against...' is not certain.

sentences.t: ወአንሰ ፡ ነዋ ፡ ፳ወ፱ ፡ ዓመት ፡ እምዘ ፡ ነገሥኩ ፡ ወበሳብዕ ፡ ዓመተ ፡ መንግሥትየ ፡ መጽአት ፡ እምከ ፡ ኀቤየ ፡ ወለእመ ፡ ፈቀደ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ያበጽሐኒ ፡ ኀበ ፡ አምጣነ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ዓቡየ ፤
sentences.l: And-I, behold, 29 years since I-reigned; and-in-the-seventh year-of my-kingdom came your-mother to-me; and-if God-wills, he-will-bring-me to as-many days-of my-father (?);
sentences.i: I, for my part, have now reigned twenty-nine years, and your mother came to me in the seventh year of my reign. If God wills, He will bring me to as many days as my father had (?);
sentences.n: ነዋ 'behold, lo'. ፳ወ፱ is the numeral 29 (20 + 9), spoken ዕሥራ ወትሱዕ in Geʿez (approximately: ʿəśra wä-təsuʿ). እምዘ ነገሥኩ 'since I reigned'. ወበሳብዕ ዓመተ መንግሥትየ 'and in the seventh year-of my-kingdom' (ዓመት in the construct, ዓመተ). እምከ 'your mother' = እም + -ከ. መጽአት 'she came' (fem.). ያበጽሐኒ 'he will cause me to arrive' (causative of በጽሐ, with -ኒ). ዓቡየ is an unclear form (?): I suspect it is a misprint or variant of አቡየ 'my father', i.e. 'as many days as David lived'; otherwise 'my great days' from ዓቢይ.

sentences.t: ወእምከመ ፡ ተወሰኩ ፡ ኀበ ፡ አበዊየ ፡ ወትነብር ፡ አንተ ፡ ዲበ ፡ መንበርየ ፡ ወትነግሥ ፡ አንተ ፡ ህየንቴየ ፡ ወሊቃውንተ ፡ እስራኤልኒ ፡ ፈድፋደ ፡ ያፈቅሩከ ፤
sentences.l: and-when I-am-added to my-fathers, you-will-sit upon my-throne and-you-will-reign in-my-place, and-the-leaders-of Israel-too all-the-more will-love-you;
sentences.i: When I am gathered to my fathers, you will sit upon my throne and reign in my place, and the leaders of Israel will love you all the more.
sentences.n: ወእምከመ 'and when'. ተወሰኩ ኀበ አበዊየ 'I am added to my fathers', the passive ተወሰከ, a Hebrew-style phrase for dying (cf. Genesis 25:8, 'gathered to his people'). መንበር 'throne, seat'. ህየንቴየ 'in my stead'. ሊቃውንተ እስራኤልኒ 'leaders-of Israel too' (-ኒ 'also'): ሊቃውንት is the plural, here in the construct. ፈድፋደ 'exceedingly, all the more'. ያፈቅሩከ 'they will love you', 3rd-person plural imperfect of ፈቀረ/አፍቀረ 'love' + -ከ.

sentences.t: ወእገብር ፡ ለከ ፡ ከብካበ ፡ ወእሁበከ ፡ ንግሥታተ ፡ ወዕቁባተ ፡ መጠነ ፡ ፈቀድከ ፤
sentences.l: and-I-shall-make for-you a-wedding-feast, and-I-shall-give-you queens and-concubines as-many-as you-wish;
sentences.i: I will prepare a wedding for you, and give you queens and concubines as many as you desire;
sentences.n: ከብካብ 'wedding, marriage celebration' (Dillmann; I take it so rather than 'honour', which is related, ?). እገብር 'I will make', እሁበከ 'I will give you': first-person imperfects. ንግሥታት 'queens' and ዕቁባት 'concubines' are feminine plurals in the accusative (ዕቁባተ with -ተ). መጠነ 'as much as, to the measure of'. ፈቀድከ 'you wished' (perfect) used as a general 'you may wish'.

sentences.t: ወትትባረክ ፡ በዛቲ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ርስት ፡ ቡርክት ፡ እንተ ፡ ወሀበ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ለአበዊነ ፡ በከመ ፡ ተካየደ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ኖሕ ፡ ገብሩ ፡ ወምስለ ፡ አብርሃም ፡ ፍቁሩ ፡ ወጻድቃን ፡ ደቂቆሙ ፡ እምድኅሬሆሙ ፡ እስከ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ አቡየ ፤
sentences.l: and-you-will-be-blessed in-this land-of inheritance blessed, which gave God to-our-fathers as he-made-covenant with Noah his-servant and-with Abraham his-beloved and-the-righteous their-sons after-them until David my-father;
sentences.i: You will be blessed in this blessed land of inheritance, which God gave to our fathers, as He made a covenant with Noah His servant, and with Abraham His beloved, and with their righteous sons after them, down to David my father;
sentences.n: ትትባረክ 'you will be blessed' (passive-reflexive stem). ምድረ ርስት 'land-of inheritance' (construct); ቡርክት is the feminine of ቡሩክ 'blessed'. እንተ ወሀበ 'which he gave' — the relative እንተ is feminine because it refers to the land. ተካየደ 'he made a covenant' (?) — a reciprocal stem from the root ከየደ 'tread, go' used for treaty-making; the sense is clear from the context (cf. Genesis 9:9 for Noah and 15:18 for Abraham). ገብሩ 'his servant', ፍቁሩ 'his beloved' (ፍቁር 'beloved'; Isaiah 41:8 calls Abraham God's 'friend'). ደቂቆሙ 'their sons' (ደቂቅ plural of ወልድ). እምድኅሬሆሙ 'after them'.

sentences.t: ወትሬእየኒ ፡ አነ ፡ ድኩም ፡ ዲበ ፡ መንበሮሙ ፡ ለአበዊየ ፡ ወትከውን ፡ ከማየ ፡ እምድኅሬየ ፡ ወትኴንን ፡ አሕዛበ ፡ ዘአልቦ ፡ ኆልቈ ፡ ወአንጋደ ፡ ዘአልቦ ፡ መስፈርተ ፤
sentences.l: and-you-will-see-me, I, a-weakling, upon their-thrones of-my-fathers, and-you-will-be like-me after-me, and-you-will-rule peoples who-have-no number and-tribes (?) who-have-no measure;
sentences.i: you will see me, weak as I am, upon the thrones of my fathers, and you will be like me after me, and you will rule peoples without number and tribes (?) without measure;
sentences.n: ወትሬእየኒ 'and you will see me' (ትሬኢ 'you see' with the object suffix -ኒ 'me'). ድኩም 'weak, feeble' — Solomon's humility. መንበሮሙ ለአበዊየ 'their thrones, of my fathers' (the anticipatory-pronoun genitive again). ትኴንን 'you will rule, judge'. አሕዛብ 'peoples, nations', ዘአልቦ 'which there is not to it', i.e. 'without' (ዘ + አልቦ + ኆልቈ 'counting, number'). አንጋድ 'tribes, sides' (?) — a form I could not confirm, read from ጋድ 'side'. መስፈርት 'measure'. A promise echoing Genesis 22:17 and 1 Kings 3:8.

sentences.t: ወታቦተ ፡ አምላከ ፡ እስራኤልኒ ፡ ለከ ፡ ወለዘርእከ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ትገብር ፡ ምሥዋዐ ፡ ወታዐርግ ፡ ጸሎተ ፡ ወእግዚኣብሔር ፡ የኀድር ፡ ውስቴታ ፡ ለዝሉፉ ፡ ወይሰምዕ ፡ ጸሎትከ ፡ በውስቴታ ፡ ወትገብር ፡ ሥምረቶ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ በውስቴታ ፡ ወዝክርከኒ ፡ ለትውልደ ፡ ትውልድ ፡ በማእከላ ፨
sentences.l: And the-ark-of the-God-of Israel too (is) for-you and-for-your-seed; it (is) where you-will-make an-altar and-offer prayer, and-God will-dwell in-it for-ever (?), and-hear your-prayer in-it, and-you-will-do his-good-pleasure, God's, in-it, and-your-remembrance-too for-generation-of generation (will be) in-its-midst.
sentences.i: And the Ark of the God of Israel also belongs to you and to your seed. It is the place where you will build an altar and offer prayer; God will dwell in it forever (?) and hear your prayer in it, and you will do His good pleasure in it, and your memory will remain in its midst from generation to generation.
sentences.n: ታቦት 'ark' is the book's central theology: the Ark of the Covenant, equated with Zion; here the king promises it to the son who will inherit it, which is exactly what the story later undoes. ታቦተ አምላከ እስራኤል 'ark-of God-of Israel' is a double construct chain (ታቦተ, አምላከ). ኀበ ትገብር 'the place where you make'. ምሥዋዕ 'altar', ታዐርግ ጸሎተ 'you offer up prayer' (ዐርገ 'ascend', causative 'offer'). የኀድር ውስቴታ 'he will dwell in it' (ውስቴታ = ውስተ + -ሃ 'in her/it'; the Ark is feminine). ለዝሉፉ 'for ever' (ዝልፈ?, ?). ሥምረቶ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'his good pleasure, God's' (ሥምረት 'good pleasure'; anticipatory pronoun again). ለትውልደ ትውልድ 'for generation-of generation', i.e. to every generation; cf. Psalm 90:1 (89:1 in the Geʿez/Greek count: 'from generation to generation'). The ፨ after በማእከላ closes Solomon's speech.

sentences.t: ወአውሥአ ፡ ወልዱ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ኦእግዚእየ ፡ ኢይከውነኒ ፡ እኅድግ ፡ ብሔርየ ፡ ወእምየ ፡ እስመ ፡ አምሕሎ ፡ አምሐለተኒ ፡ እምየ ፡ በአጥባቲሃ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይቁም ፡ ዝየ ፡ አላ ፡ እግባእ ፡ ኀቤሃ ፡ ፍጡነ ፡ ወበዝየኒ ፡ ኢያውስብ ፡ ብእሲተ ፤
sentences.l: And-answered his-son and-said-to-him: O my-lord, not-possible-for-me that-I-leave my-country and-my-mother, for an-oath she-made-me-swear, my-mother, by-her-breasts, that he-not (for I-not) stay here but that-I-return to-her quickly, and-here-too he-not (for I-not) take a-wife;
sentences.i: His son answered him: 'My lord, I cannot leave my country and my mother, for my mother made me swear an oath by her breasts that I would not stay here, but would return to her quickly, and that I would not take a wife here either;
sentences.n: ኦእግዚእየ 'O my lord' (እግዚእ 'lord' + -የ 'my'): a respectful way for a son to address his father and king. አምሕሎ አምሐለተኒ 'an oath she made me swear' — a cognate construction (አምሐለ 'make swear' with its own noun አምሕሎ 'oath'), common in Geʿez for emphasis. በአጥባቲሃ 'by her breasts' (አጥባት, plural of ጥብ 'breast'). ከመ ኢይቁም 'that he not stand/stay' — the verb is 3rd person, though the sense is 'I' (?): the oath is reported, so persons shift. እግባእ 'that I return'. ፍጡነ 'quickly'. ወበዝየኒ 'and here too'. ኢያውስብ 'that he not take a wife' (አውሰበ 'take a wife', causative).

sentences.t: ወታቦተ ፡ አምላከ ፡ እስራኤልሂ ፡ ትባርከኒ ፡ በኀበ ፡ ሀለውኩ ፡ ወጸሎትከኒ ፡ ትትልወኒ ፡ በኀበ ፡ ሖርኩ ፡ እስመ ፡ ፈተውኩ ፡ እርአይ ፡ ገጸከ ፡ ወእስማዕ ፡ ቃለከ ፡ ወእንሣእ ፡ በረከትከ ፡ ወእሖር ፡ ኀበ ፡ እምየ ፡ በዳኅን ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: and-the-ark-of the-God-of Israel too will-bless-me where I-am, and-your-prayer-too will-accompany-me where I-go; for I-desired that-I-see your-face, and-that-I-hear your-word, and-that-I-take your-blessing, and-that-I-go to my-mother in-peace.'
sentences.i: And the Ark of the God of Israel will bless me wherever I am, and your prayer will go with me wherever I go. For I desired to see your face, to hear your word, to receive your blessing, and then to go to my mother in peace.'
sentences.n: ታቦተ አምላከ እስራኤልሂ 'the ark-of the-God-of Israel also' (-ሂ 'also'): the son accepts the Ark as a blessing but not as a reason to stay. ትባርከኒ 'she will bless me'; ትትልወኒ 'she will accompany me' (ተልወ 'follow, accompany'); the verbs are feminine because ታቦት and ጸሎት are feminine nouns. በኀበ ሀለውኩ 'in the place where I am', በኀበ ሖርኩ 'where I go'. ፈተውኩ 'I wished, I loved'. እርአይ, እስማዕ, እንሣእ, እሖር are first-person subjunctives, 'that I see... hear... take... go'. በረከት 'blessing'. በዳኅን 'in peace, safely'. The run of ፨ marks the end of the chapter and part.
